title: SEO Manager
description:
**About Us**

* Mentor junior team members and support delivery excellence within the team

* Utilize tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and Looker Studio for analysis and reporting



  





**Requirements** 



* 4\-6 years of experience in SEO, preferably within a digital marketing agency environment
* Strong understanding of Technical SEO, On\-Page SEO and Content SEO
* Experience in independently handling client communication and SEO operations
* Hands\-on experience with SEO reporting and presentation decks
* Good analytical, presentation and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to manage multiple accounts in a fast\-paced environment
* Understanding of GEO and evolving AI\-led search ecosystems will be an added advantage



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience working on large or enterprise\-level websites
* Basic understanding of HTML, CMS platforms and SEO implementation workflows
* Strong ownership mindset and problem\-solving ability
* Team handling and operational coordination experience

title: Senior Manager - Digital Marketing
description:
***Job Description – Senior Manager – Digital Marketing***




 Can you turn digital marketing into a measurable growth engine?
 



  





 Viceroy Properties is looking for a Senior Manager – Digital Marketing to own and scale digital growth across our brand and projects. This is a high\-ownership, commercially focused role for someone who understands the complete digital funnel, from audience strategy, media and content to lead generation, CRM, site visits, bookings and ROI.
 



  





 As a
 **Senior Manager – Digital Marketing** 
 , you will be responsible for\-
 



**1\. Digital Growth Strategy \& Performance Leadership** 



* Own the end\-to\-end digital growth strategy across Viceroy’s brand and projects.
* Lead performance marketing across Google, Meta, YouTube and emerging platforms.
* Own media investments with accountability for CPL, CAC, conversion and ROAS.
* Build a strong test\-and\-learn culture across audiences, creatives, channels and campaigns.



**2\. Demand Generation \& Revenue Conversion** 



* Build scalable strategies that generate high\-quality demand, not just lead volumes.
* Own and optimise the funnel: Click → Lead → Qualified Lead → Site Visit → Booking.
* Partner with Sales \& CRM to improve lead quality, conversion and revenue contribution.
* Build audience segmentation, remarketing and nurture strategies that move customers through the funnel.



**3\. Customer Journey, Data \& Growth Intelligence** 



* Own the digital customer journey across websites, landing pages and key digital touchpoints.
* Build a strong measurement ecosystem across GA4, GTM, CRM, attribution and conversion tracking.
* Connect media investment → leads → site visits → bookings → revenue through clear dashboards and insights.
* Drive SEO, CRO and continuous optimisation of digital experiences.
* Turn data into actionable insights that influence marketing and business decisions.



**4\. Digital Innovation \& Future Growth** 



* Identify new opportunities across AI, automation, martech, emerging platforms and changing consumer behaviour.
* Partner with Brand \& Creative to develop content that delivers both
 **brand impact and performance** 
 .
* Drive continuous experimentation to find new audiences, channels and growth opportunities.
* Challenge existing approaches and bring a strong point of view on what Viceroy should do next digitally.



**5\. Leadership \& Strategic Business Partnership** 



* Partner closely with Senior Management, Sales, CRM and Brand on business and project priorities.
* Lead internal teams and external media, SEO, creative and technology partners with clear accountability.
* Translate business and sales priorities into effective digital growth strategies.
* Bring together commercial
 
 thinking, customer understanding and digital expertise to influence business outcomes.



  





  





**Who We’re Looking For** 



* 8\+ years in Digital/Performance Marketing, ideally across Real Estate and/or Luxury.
* Proven track record of managing significant media investments and delivering measurable growth.
* Deep understanding of Google \& Meta Ads, analytics, attribution, SEO, CRM funnels and conversion optimisation.
* Strong combination of commercial thinking, analytical depth and creative instinct.
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strategic yet hands\-on, able to set direction while getting into the details when it matters.
* High ownership, ambition, curiosity and pace.



  





  





**About Viceroy Properties** 




 Viceroy Properties was founded in 2017 with the ambition to redefine luxury real estate development in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. With a strong focus on Meticulous Planning, Aesthetic Design and Impeccable Craftsmanship, our projects have received multiple international awards across Design, Construction and Sustainability.
 



 As we enter our next phase of growth, we are building an organisation and brand capable of delivering exceptional developments at greater scale. Digital will play a critical role in how we build our brand, reach customers and drive growth and this role will be at the centre of that journey.

title: Manager - Brand & Performance Marketing
description:
**Manager – Brand \& Performance Marketing** 




  





**Years of Experience:** 
 4\-6 years
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai (MIDC, Andheri)
 



  





 We’re looking for a marketer who can think
 **brand and business at the same time** 
 .
 



 Someone who understands how to build a brand across traditional and new\-age media, create campaigns people notice, and equally understands what happens after someone clicks an ad.
 



 This role will work across
 **brand, media, performance marketing, activations and the customer acquisition funnel** 
 , with accountability extending beyond leads to actual customer activation.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  





**Brand \& Campaigns** 




 Own and execute integrated brand campaigns across digital and traditional channels.
 



 Work closely with creative and media agencies to translate business objectives into strong campaign ideas, communication and media plans.
 



 Have a strong understanding of
 **copy, messaging and creative development** 
 , with the ability to recognise what makes an ad work.
 



 Develop campaign briefs, evaluate creative routes and ensure consistency across channels and customer touchpoints.
 



  





**Media Planning \& Buying** 




 Plan and manage campaigns across
 **traditional and new\-age media** 
 , including digital and social media, Google, YouTube, Meta, programmatic, OTT/CTV, print, radio, OOH/DOOH and emerging channels.
 



 Work with media partners and agencies on planning, buying, optimisation, measurement and campaign effectiveness.
 



 Understand the role different media channels play across
 **awareness, consideration, acquisition and conversion** 
 .
 



  





**Performance Marketing** 




 Work closely on performance campaigns with a clear understanding of metrics such as
 **CAC, CPL, CPI, CTR, conversion rate, ROAS and customer activation costs** 
 .
 



 Understand audience segmentation, retargeting, creative testing, landing page optimisation and campaign optimisation.
 



 Be comfortable analysing campaign performance and identifying where acquisition funnels are leaking.
 



 Importantly, this person should understand that
 **performance marketing does not end when a lead or app download is generated.** 




  





**Understand the Full Acquisition Funnel** 




 Understand and help optimise the complete customer journey:
 



**Ad → Click → App Download → Account Opening → KYC Completion → Account Activation → First Trade → Active Customer** 




 Work with Product, Analytics, CRM, Business and Digital teams to understand conversion at every stage.
 



 Identify funnel drop\-offs and work on interventions such as communication, remarketing, nudges, product journeys and campaigns that improve conversion.
 



 Understand cohorts and identify which campaigns, audiences and channels ultimately produce
 **activated and transacting customers** 
 , rather than simply cheap leads or downloads.
 



  





**Activations \& Experiential Marketing** 




 Conceptualise and execute
 **brand activations, experiential campaigns, partnerships and on\-ground initiatives** 
 .
 



 Think beyond conventional events to create experiences that generate conversations, participation and measurable business impact.
 



 Connect offline activations with digital journeys wherever possible so that engagement can translate into measurable acquisition.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




**4 to 6 years of experience** 
 across brand, media, digital and/or performance marketing, ideally in a consumer\-facing business.
 



 Experience working across both
 **traditional and digital/new\-age media** 
 .
 



 Hands\-on understanding of
 **performance marketing and digital acquisition** 
 .
 



 Experience executing
 **brand activations and experiential campaigns** 
 .
 



 Strong creative judgement and a good understanding of
 **copy, campaign ideas and communication** 
 .
 



 Strong understanding of the
 **customer acquisition and conversion funnel beyond lead generation** 
 .
 



 Comfort with data, dashboards and campaign analytics.
 



 Ability to work cross\-functionally with
 **Product, Business, Analytics, CRM, Sales, Digital and Creative teams** 
 .
 



 Agency experience combined with client\-side experience would be an advantage.
 



 Experience in
 **fintech, BFSI, broking, consumer internet, e\-commerce or other digital\-first businesses** 
 would be relevant.
 



  





**The Mindset We’re Looking For** 




  





 We don’t want someone who thinks:
 



**“The campaign delivered 100,000 downloads. Job done.”** 




 We want someone who asks:
 



**How many opened an account? How many completed the journey? How many made their first trade? Which campaign brought us the highest\-quality customers? Where are customers dropping off? What can marketing do to move more people through the funnel?** 




 At the same time, we’re not looking for a performance marketer who only sees dashboards and CAC.
 



 The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable discussing a
 **brand idea, a billboard, an experiential activation, a Meta campaign and an acquisition funnel.** 




 That’s the combination we’re looking for.

Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000\+ real devices and browsers.
   

  

 With over 1,200 employees and a remote\-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto\-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
   

  

**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
****Role in a Nutshell****
 As a Senior Associate \- Outbound Marketing, you will be a core problem\-solver responsible for owning the marketing pipeline and delivering on pipeline commits. Initially, you will define the strategy and own the end\-to\-end funnel for our outbound marketing initiatives—focusing on strategy and funnel conversion to generate tangible business value rather than requiring deep, technical platform\-level expertise.
   

  

 Beyond this initial focus, this role requires high flexibility and strategic agility. You will be expected to adapt and own evolving problem statements in the near future, spanning various channels and broader marketing pipeline goals. While experience in generating business value from outbound channels is a plus, the true focus of this role is on solving complex growth problems, building scalable solutions, and aligning seamlessly with BrowserStack’s broader business goals.
   

  

****Desired Experience****
* 2\.5–4 years of overall experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, with high adaptability to navigate evolving problem statements.
* Proven ability to solve complex channel problems, think strategically, and drive execution with strong attention to detail.
* Strong data\-driven decision\-making skills with deep comfort working with pipeline data.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience leading or influencing cross\-functional teams.
* Knowledge of outbound marketing best practices including content, audience and infrastructural nuances


****What You Will Do****
* Define and execute the outbound marketing strategy in alignment with broader business objectives.
* Experiment continuously to optimize funnel conversion rates and rigorously analyze incremental impact.
* Identify opportunities for growth and efficiency, breaking down complex pipeline challenges into clear, actionable, and scalable solutions.
* Work seamlessly with cross\-functional teams (Events, Marketing, Business Operations, and Sales) to prioritize initiatives using data and research.
* Stay updated on industry trends, competitive landscapes, and emerging opportunities to continuously sharpen the strategic growth plan.


**Benefits**
 In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:
   

  

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents\-in\-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual \& Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life\-event leaves
* Remote\-First work environment that allows our people to work from home
* Remote\-First Allowance for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co\-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience

title: Co-Founder, Chief Marketing & Transformation Officer(CMTO) with Investment
description:
**Company:** 
 Yuvrus Botanicals Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Industry:** 
 Child Nutrition \| Natural FMCG \| Wellness
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai / Hybrid
 



**Role:** 
 Full\-Time \| Co\-Founder \| Leadership \& Investment Role
 



  





**About Yuvrus Botanicals:** 




**Yuvrus Botanicals is building a new generation of trusted child nutrition and wellness products** 
 , combining the wisdom of nature with modern paediatric science.
 



  





**Better Nutrition. Better Choices. Better Futures.** 




  





**Beginning with our flagship child nutrition product Choco Genius** 
 , we are building a broader portfolio of natural nutrition and care products for children.
 



 Our ambition is bigger than building another FMCG brand:
 



  





**We aspire to build one of India's most trusted child nutrition brands — a brand mothers know, trust, choose, recommend and pass on.** 




  





**The Opportunity** 




**We are looking for a Co\-Founder \& Chief Marketing \& Transformation Officer (CMTO)** 
 to own and build the complete
 **Brand, Marketing, Growth, Consumer and Transformation engine** 
 of Yuvrus Botanicals.
 



 This is
 **not a traditional CMO role.** 




**We are looking for a hands\-on builder and growth operator** 
 who can take Yuvrus from:
 



**0 → 1 → 10 → 100** 




**You will personally drive early\-stage campaigns, identify what works, build repeatable growth systems, create a powerful consumer brand and eventually transform marketing into a data\-driven, technology\-enabled and increasingly automated growth engine.** 




**Brand → Attention → Trust → Acquisition → Conversion → Retention → Advocacy → Scale** 




**The goal is not simply to run campaigns.** 




**The goal is to build the machine that continuously creates demand, customers, revenue and brand equity.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Build the Yuvrus Brand** 




**Own the evolution of Yuvrus from an early\-stage startup into a nationally trusted child nutrition brand** 
 .
 


* Brand positioning and differentiation
* Consumer proposition and storytelling
* Brand voice and creative strategy
* Packaging and communication
* Founder and mother\-led storytelling
* Consumer trust strategy
* Brand consistency and guidelines



**When a mother thinks about child nutrition, Yuvrus should be one of the first brands that comes to mind.** 




  





**2\. Own Performance Marketing \& Revenue Growth** 




**You must be exceptionally strong in performance marketing** 
 and comfortable owning revenue numbers.
 



 Lead and scale:
 


* Meta Ads
* Google Ads
* YouTube
* Marketplace advertising
* D2C acquisition
* Retargeting \& remarketing
* Affiliate and social commerce



 Own and optimise:
 



**CAC \| ROAS \| MER \| CPA \| CTR \| CVR \| AOV \| LTV \| LTV:CAC \| Contribution Margin** 




**You should be able to answer:** 




**“If we invest ₹1 crore in marketing, how much profitable revenue can we generate?”** 




**Marketing success will be measured by profitable growth, not vanity metrics.** 




  





**3\. Build the 0 → ₹100 Cr Growth Engine** 




**Own the journey:** 




**₹0 → ₹1 Cr → ₹10 Cr → ₹50 Cr → ₹100 Cr\+** 




**Identify winning channels, audiences, creatives, campaigns and offers** 
 , then build systems to scale them.
 



 You should be comfortable moving from:
 



**Doing → Building → Scaling → Systemising → Automating** 




**Initially, you may personally launch and optimise campaigns. As Yuvrus scales, build the team, technology, dashboards, SOPs, automation and AI systems** 
 required to make growth increasingly predictable and founder\-independent.
 



  





**4\. Content Marketing \& Consumer Storytelling** 




**Build Yuvrus into a content\-led child nutrition brand** 
 .
 



 Own content across:
 


* Instagram, YouTube and social platforms
* Reels and short\-form video
* UGC and creator content
* Founder and expert\-led content
* Educational and parent\-focused content
* SEO and blogs
* Influencer partnerships
* Community content



 Turn:
 



**Consumer Insight → Idea → Content → Distribution → Engagement → Conversion** 




**You should be able to identify why content works and turn winning concepts into scalable creative systems.** 




  





**5\. Creative \+ Performance** 




**Understand that in modern D2C:** 




**Creative is the new targeting.** 




**Build and test:** 



* High\-converting ad creatives
* UGC scripts
* Hooks and storyboards
* Testimonials
* Product demonstrations
* Educational/problem\-solution creatives
* Social proof
* Founder/expert stories



 Continuously test:
 



**Hook × Creative × Audience × Offer × Landing Page × CTA** 




**and scale combinations that produce sustainable economics.** 




  





**6\. Build the Trust Engine** 




**Child nutrition is fundamentally a trust category** 
 .
 



 Build consumer confidence through:
 


* Scientific communication
* Paediatric credibility
* Ingredient education
* Product transparency
* Parent education
* Expert collaborations
* Reviews and testimonials
* UGC and community
* Quality communication
* Mother\-led storytelling



**“Yuvrus is a brand I can trust with my child.”** 




**That should become the consumer reaction we earn.** 




  





**7\. Consumer Intelligence, CRM \& Retention** 




**Build systems to understand:** 



* Why parents buy or don't buy
* What creates trust and hesitation
* Consumer and competitor trends
* Pricing and product opportunities
* Content and channel opportunities



 Build:
 



**First Purchase → Second Purchase → Habit → Loyalty → Advocacy** 




**Own CRM, WhatsApp, email, loyalty, referrals, segmentation, personalisation and lifecycle marketing.** 




  





**8\. AI, Technology \& Marketing Transformation** 




**Yuvrus intends to become an AI\-first FMCG company** 
 .
 



 Identify and implement:
 


* AI\-assisted content creation
* Marketing automation
* CRM and segmentation
* Predictive analytics
* Personalisation
* Automated campaign optimisation
* Attribution and dashboards
* Automated reporting
* Creative testing
* Consumer intelligence
* AI\-powered decision support



**Build a marketing organisation where technology and AI multiply human capability and reduce operational dependency.** 




  





**9\. Build the Marketing Organisation \& Operating System** 




**Initially be a hands\-on builder** 
 and progressively build a high\-performance team across:
 



**Brand \| Performance \| Growth \| Content \| Creative \| Social \| Influencers \| CRM \| E\-commerce \| Analytics** 




**Establish:** 



* Annual and quarterly growth plans
* Campaign calendars
* Weekly growth reviews
* CAC/ROAS/LTV dashboards
* Cohort and conversion tracking
* Attribution
* Creative testing
* Marketing SOPs
* Campaign post\-mortems



 Every marketing rupee should answer:
 



**Where did it go? What did it generate? What did we learn? Should we scale, optimise or stop?** 




  





**Who You Are** 




**We are looking for a builder, not a caretaker.** 




**You should be:** 



* A proven marketing and growth leader
* **Exceptional in performance marketing**
* **Excellent in content marketing**
* **Highly analytical and commercially minded**
* **Obsessed with ROAS and profitable growth**
* **Strong in CAC/LTV economics**
* **Experienced in D2C and e\-commerce**
* **Strong in brand building and storytelling**
* **Experienced in influencer/creator marketing**
* **Comfortable with A/B testing and experimentation**
* **Strong in marketing analytics and consumer research**
* **Comfortable building teams and agencies**
* **Comfortable with ambiguity and limited resources**
* **Entrepreneurial and comfortable owning revenue outcomes**
* **Excited to build from scratch**



**You should want to build something you can call your own.** 




  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* MBA / PGDM from IIM / ISB / IIT / equivalent reputed global institution preferred
* **10\+ years** 
 in marketing, growth, FMCG, D2C, food, nutrition, wellness, baby care or consumer brands
* Proven experience scaling a consumer business from early stage
* Hands\-on expertise in
 **Performance Marketing**
* **Strong expertise in Meta, Google, YouTube and digital acquisition**
* **Strong understanding of ROAS, MER, CAC, LTV, contribution margin and retention**
* **Strong Content Marketing** 
 experience
* Experience with D2C, marketplaces, influencers and creators
* Experience implementing CRM and marketing automation
* Experience building high\-performance teams
* Excellent communication, storytelling and leadership skills



**Preferred Industry:** 
 Child Nutrition \| Baby Care \| FMCG \| Food \| Nutraceuticals \| Wellness \| Ayurveda \| Parenting \| Healthcare
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




**You will be measured on business outcomes** 
 , not vanity metrics.
 



**Brand:** 
 Awareness \| Consideration \| Search \| Trust \| Share of Voice
 



**Growth:** 
 Revenue \| CAC \| ROAS \| MER \| LTV \| LTV:CAC \| Conversion \| Repeat Purchase \| Retention \| Contribution Margin
 



**Content:** 
 Organic Growth \| Engagement \| UGC \| Creator Performance \| Content\-to\-Commerce Conversion
 



**Transformation:** 
 Automation \| AI Adoption \| Team Productivity \| SOPs \| Reporting \| Reduced Founder Dependency
 



**Ultimate KPI: Can Yuvrus continue growing even when the founder is not personally driving every campaign?** 




  





**What You Get** 



* **Co\-Founder \& Chief Marketing \& Transformation Officer title**
* **Meaningful equity ownership with investment participation**
* **Direct ownership of Brand, Growth, Marketing \& Transformation**
* **Salary post\-fundraise, aligned with market standards and role scope**
* **Significant strategic decision\-making authority**
* **Opportunity to build a high\-performance marketing organisation**
* **Opportunity to build a national D2C \+ FMCG brand**
* **Long\-term ownership in a high\-growth natural wellness company**
* **Opportunity to work directly with the founding team**



  





**The Co\-Founder Mindset** 




**This is not for someone looking for a conventional CMO job.** 




**It is for someone who wants to build.** 




**Someone who doesn't ask:** 




**“What is my marketing budget?”** 




**but asks:** 




**“What is the fastest responsible way to build consumer trust and create ₹100 Cr of sustainable demand?”** 




**Someone who doesn't say:** 




**“My agency will handle it.”** 




**but says:** 




**“I own the outcome.”** 




**You don't want to simply manage an established brand. You want to build one.** 




  





**Our Mission** 




**Every child deserves better nutrition. Every mother deserves better choices.** 




  





**If you are ready to put your experience, network, leadership, entrepreneurial energy and capital** 
 behind building a brand that millions of mothers can trust:
 



**We should talk.** 




  





**Build the Brand. Build the Growth Engine. Build the Future of Child Nutrition.** 




**Apply to become Co\-Founder \& Chief Marketing \& Transformation Officer at Yuvrus Botanicals..**

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**About Role:** 




 We are seeking a versatile Marketing Manager to drive integrated B2B marketing communications, brand building, content marketing and end\-to\-end event and community management within the AdTech in India, SEA \& MEA regions.. This role owns the marketing calendar, brand narrative and event strategy, while partnering closely with sales and strategic accounts to amplify reach and engagement.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong marketing craft, brand storytelling, content strategy, campaign execution and flawless event management, with the ability to translate complex programmatic, DSP and digital media capabilities into compelling customer\-facing narratives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Events, Community \& Experiential Marketing** 



* Event Strategy \& Ownership: Own the end\-to\-end planning, budgeting, logistics and execution of industry events, roundtables, webinars, executive forums, conferences and sponsorships — from concept to on\-ground delivery.
* Experiential Marketing: Design immersive brand experiences and event formats that strengthen brand recall and deepen engagement with advertisers, agencies and ecosystem partners.
* Event Calendar Management: Build and manage an annual marketing events calendar aligned to industry conferences, award shows and speaking opportunities.
* Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination: Manage relationships with event agencies, venues, vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless, on\-brand execution within timelines and budget.
* Post\-Event Marketing: Drive post\-event content (recaps, photo/video assets, social amplification, follow\-up communications) to extend the marketing value of every event.



**Brand, Content \& Product Marketing** 



* Market Positioning \& Narrative: Build and solidify brand positioning as a top\-tier DSP/programmatic platform, translating complex AdTech, data and measurement capabilities into clear, compelling marketing messaging.
* Thought Leadership \& Content Marketing: Oversee the end\-to\-end production of industry reports, whitepapers, podcasts, webinars, articles and executive\-led content that strengthen brand authority and visibility across the advertising ecosystem.
* Go\-To\-Market (GTM) Marketing: Design GTM and messaging frameworks for new product features, tech integrations and capability launches to support market adoption.
* Ecosystem \& PR Engagement: Secure speaking engagements, industry awards, media coverage and participation in premier AdTech and digital marketing forums.



**Integrated Marketing Campaigns** 



* Multi\-Channel Marketing Campaigns: Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital media, LinkedIn, email marketing, programmatic channels and events to build brand awareness and audience engagement.
* Marketing Collateral \& Sales Enablement: Develop high\-impact marketing assets, pitch decks, brochures, case studies, customer proof points and ROI narratives that support sales conversations and shorten deal cycles.
* Co\-Marketing Partnerships: Build strategic co\-marketing initiatives with agencies, advertisers, publishers, data partners and tech vendors to extend brand reach.
* Marketing Performance \& Analytics: Track and report on marketing performance metrics (engagement, reach, share of voice, campaign ROI, event attendance/impact) to continuously refine strategy.



**Strategic Account \& Ecosystem Marketing** 



* Account\-Based Marketing (ABM): Build tailored marketing programs and content targeting priority enterprise verticals and key strategic accounts.
* Client \& Partner Engagement: Support strategic account relationships through marketing touchpoints, executive presentations, curated event invitations and tailored content.
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Establish strong feedback loops across Product, Sales and Customer Success to continuously refine marketing messaging and positioning.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements:**

 BharatNXT is a business payments platform on a mission to transform how Indian MSMEs manage their working capital. With a growing user base and robust product roadmap, we’re now setting our sights on building a high\-conversion, high\-traffic website from scratch.

**Organic Growth Lead**

* Conceptualize and execute
 
**webinars, seminars, and podcasts**

**testimonial loops, referral programs, and UGC campaigns** 

 to fuel trust and virality.
* Build a credible
 
**social media presence** 

 through organic LinkedIn, YouTube SEO, Twitter/X, etc.

**organic PR efforts** 

 with financial/SME publications to boost visibility and backlinks.

**ASO optimization** 

 strategies to improve BharatNXT’s discoverability and conversion on app stores.

 .

**founding Organic Growth hire**

**AI, community, content, and virality**

**brand visibility, user trust, and inbound demand** 

 .

 We are M\&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M\&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

 Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
   

  

 Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M\&G is transforming as a business.
   

  

**About M\&G**
 Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
   

  

 Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long\-term investment and savings solutions.
   

  

 Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Drive high quality business and market intel to support strategic decision making for the senior business executives. Deliver funds, sector and market analysis and recommendation to various stakeholders in the Product, Distribution, and Investment areas.
* Drive the production of regular reporting outputs, focusing on accuracy, timeliness and meaningful insights.
* Deliver regular reporting including peer group analysis and Executive Committee updates for M\&G wholesale public funds, while fulfilling bespoke market insight requests from various business areas.
* Assist in delivering thematic research by analysing major industry and investor trends.
* Ensure MI inputs are embedded into key business discussions and planning materials to support informed decisions.
* Manage senior stakeholders’ expectations and service their requests with high quality analysis and on time delivery.
* Contribute to forward‑looking market, sector and fund analysis.
* Support continuous improvement in MI processes, reporting efficiency and use of automation and visualisation.
* Support and contribute to team automation initiatives to improve efficiency and enable Sales teams to self\-serve fund comparison request.
* Contribute to the strategic projects of Asset Management strategy and support strategic business plan of Investment business as part of the Distribution function in M\&G.
* Manage compelling deadlines, where necessary, to ensure commentaries are produced in a timely and accurate manner.


**Key Accountabilities:**
* Accountable for delivering high quality commentaries, using specialist knowledge and subject matter expertise
* Accountable for providing market and industry context for M\&G’s three year business planning.
* Apply judgement to deliver outcomes, ensuring meeting of business deadlines
* Manage conflicts that may impact delivery
* Identify and anticipate need for changes to continuously improve quality and efficiency of output
* Liaise with external providers such as Broadridge, Morningstar, and IA to handle queries and maintain organisational data accuracy


**Key Stakeholder Management**
**Internal**
* Head of Wholesale Market Intelligence
* Director of Strategy \& Market Intelligence
* Chief Strategy and Transformation Officer, Asset Management
* Stakeholders across business areas but not limited to Product, Distribution, Investment teams
* Head of Client Operations \- Asset Management


**External**
* Not applicable


**Knowledge, Skills, Experience \& Educational Qualification**
**Knowledge \& Skills :**
* Extensive experience in market intelligence, competitive analysis or related roles within asset management.
* Good understanding of asset management products, distribution channels and competitor dynamics.
* Strong ability to synthesise complex, multi\-source data into clear, commercially relevant insight.
* Experience using Morningstar Direct database
* Working knowledge of Broadridge/IA Echoweb/ eVestment database is desirable
* Knowledge of data visualisation platforms such as Microsoft Power BI
* Team management and project management experience
* Senior stakeholders management
* Good planning and prioritising skills
* Committed to achieving results independently and to deliver on time
* Strong verbal as well as written communication skills
* Rigorous attention to detail, planning and organisation skills
* Able to work both individually and in a collegiate and collaborative manner


**Experience:**
* 8\-10\+ years’ experience in Asset Management/ Wealth Management industry
* Experience in working with senior leaders and investment professionals across global teams


**Educational Qualification:**
* Post Graduate preferably with degree in Commerce/Business Administration specialised in Finance/Marketing/Operations
* Masters in Finance preferred


 We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M\&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
In the role as
 **Key Account Manager** 
 , you will contribute to our purpose of Bringing People Closer. You will be responsible for expanding, strengthening, and optimizing the dealer network across the region. The role will focus on driving sales growth, improving dealer performance, increasing market penetration, and building a sustainable distribution ecosystem aligned with company strategy.
   

  

**Your Contribution Is Appreciated, And You Responsibilities Include**
* Dealer Network Expansion
* Identify, appoint, and onboard new dealers across key territories.
* Strengthen presence in emerging and underpenetrated markets.
* Implement structured coverage planning and territory mapping.
* Dealer Relationship Management
* Drive business growth from the existing dealer network with clear nurture and ramp\-up plans.
* Build long\-term partnerships with key dealers and chain clinics.
* Conduct regular business reviews and ensure strong engagement and brand loyalty.
* Sales Growth \& Target Achievement
* Deliver regional sales targets through the dealer network.
* Monitor dealer performance, productivity, and profitability.
* Develop incentive schemes and promotional programs to boost sell\-out.
* Market Development \& Competitive Strategy
* Track competitor activities, pricing trends, and new launches.
* Strengthen presence in key price segments (especially the premium range).
* Support dealers with local market activation initiatives.
* Operational Excellence
* Ensure smooth coordination between dealers and internal teams (Supply Chain, Service, Marketing).
* Monitor inventory levels and optimize stock planning.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and pricing discipline.
* Reporting \& Analytics
* Prepare monthly sales forecasts and performance reports.
* Analyse performance data to identify growth opportunities and corrective actions.
* Present strategic insights to senior leadership.


**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:**
* Postgraduate qualification; MBA is preferred (Sales / Marketing / Business Management).
* 15–20 years of experience in Sales and Channel Development, preferably in allied or similar industries.
* Strong exposure to dealer and distribution network management.
* Experience in medical devices, hearing aids, healthcare, or consumer electronics preferred.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets.
* Strong negotiation and relationship\-building skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India (18–20 days per month).
* Ability to lead and manage a team of 12–18 members, with 5 Zonal Sales Managers reporting directly.


**We encourage you to apply**
 Even if you don’t match all the above\-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferrable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.
   

  

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process**
 All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.
   

  

 Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.
   

  

**How to apply?**
 Use the ‘APPLY’ link as soon as poosible. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.
   

  

**Join us in bringing people closer**
 GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhance the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss overcome real\-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.
   

  

**We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.**

Business development: ? Manage client accounts, build professional relationships, and meet business development targets by identifying new opportunities with existing clients. ? Build a strong team and be a strong role model, mentor and coach ? Assist in resolving people issues ? Support people development through guidance and feedback ? Take the lead in recruiting activities ? Ensure compliance to the EY’s standards, processes and policies ? Contribute to the firm’s initiatives in enhancing market leadership \& growth, quality, people agenda and opera\- tional excellence ? The role will evolve from engagement delivery to engagement management and pro\-active business development over time


**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**
* MBA from Tier\-I


**Experience**
* 5\-7 years of relevant post qualification experience, preferably from Consulting or Tech services industry with significant expertise in at least three of the areas listed – Due diligence, Go to Market, Revenue acceleration, Growth Strategy, Profitability improvement, Talent Supply Chain, Operations Transformation


**What We Look For**
 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side\-by\-side with market\-leading entrepreneurs, game\-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. title: Customer Success Manager- Marketing cloud
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high\-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and
   

  

 advice to customer organizations. The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems. The CSM serving Marketing Cloud customers acts as the primary Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration and needs of the customer.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Customer Accountability and Value Alignment
   

  

* Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
* Signature Lifecycle Oversight: Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
* Value Delivery: Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
* Prioritization: Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Internal Resource Utilization: Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.


**Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management**
* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive\-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
* Innovation Partnership: Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
* Customer Engagement: Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.


**Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management**
* AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
* Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural\-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
* AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI\-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
* Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
* Learning \& Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
* Proactive Reviews: Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Incident Management: Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
* Cross\-functional Relationships: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* Client Engagement Planning: Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision\-making.


**Minimum Requirements**
 Preferred/Mandatory Qualifications and Skills
   

  

* Experience (Mandatory): Experienced business professional with 9\+ years of relevant industry expertise, including a mandatory minimum of 2\+ years of direct, hands\-on experience working with the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement / Pardot, or Marketing Cloud Next) in a customer success, administrator, consultant, or marketing operations capacity. Candidates without demonstrated Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience will not be considered for this role.
* Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C\-level conversations.
* Domain Expertise: Possess industry\-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
* Learning \& Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.


**Cloud Specific Experience**
 Salesforce product certifications are required for this role. Recommended Marketing Cloud certifications:
   

  

* Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator — hands\-on experience configuring Marketing Cloud products using industry and product best practices.
* Marketing Cloud Email Specialist — proven knowledge of email marketing best practices, message design, subscriber \& data management, and inbox delivery.
* Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist — skills in designing, building, and implementing marketing workflows through the Account Engagement (Pardot) platform.
* Marketing Cloud Engagement Consultant — ability to create multi\-channel campaign solutions using the full suite of Marketing Cloud tools.


 Unleash Your Potential

 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Marketing Manager (Product Owner-Web Experience)
description:
Our Senior Product Owner is a lead role within our Web Experience team, as the primary owner of our website development strategy across a growing group of sites including HERE.com, plus our Japan and Legal sites. Within our multi\-discipline team, you’ll be responsible for defining and executing our site experience roadmap that will solve our user’s needs, create a pathway to HERE platform sign\-ups and deliver against our core website KPIs. You will work closely with colleagues across Infrastructure, User Experience and Content, as well as stakeholders in the Marketing, Product and Technology organizations, with a key focus on cross\-functional collaboration to deliver against aligned strategic business goals.
 



  





 In addition, you’ll be responsible for planning and overseeing our in\-house team’s resource allocation and quality of output to ensure delivery of a a competitive and effective product as our flagship website. From research to product development, you’ll build consensus, solicit feedback, manage ticketed progress and negotiate priorities with all levels of stakeholders as you plan and execute for best practice digital experience.
 



  





 MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
 


* Oversee the development and delivery of our annual strategic roadmap to achieve our vision for growth as a multi\-audience destination website that helps visitors understand who HERE is, the problems HERE solves and experience easy access to our GTM strategy options from sales engagement to self\-service.
* Use your in\-depth expertise to build improved understanding of the here.com roadmap by being the lead communicator of key delivered milestones that reflect optimized experience, and improved engagement and conversion, from multiple target audiences. This includes supporting growth in discovery, lead generation, platform sign\-ups and thought leadership engagement.
* Define, prioritize, and oversee the execution of Web Experience roadmap. Manage sprint planning and ticket creation, sprint demos, BDD (Behavior\-Driven Development) workflows, UAT, and releases in conjunction with internal developers using Jira and GitLab.
* Oversee sprint planning \& management (including sprint demos, UAT, releases) by engaging with Web Experience colleagues before planning work in Jira and running regular check\-ins.
* Identify, understand and communicate user’s pain points, translating them into roadmapped activities that improve user experience, site performance and achieve agreed here.com KPIs.
* Ensure consistency, quality, and scalability of our global website CMS, Contentful. description:
**Role Definition** 




 A Marketing Executive is the on\-ground marketing person for the brand, working across the Dadar and Panvel stores. The role shoots content inside the stores, runs the brand's day\-to\-day Instagram and LinkedIn, engages the audience, supports WhatsApp marketing and passes leads to store managers, and plans each week with the marketing team and the social media agency.  • Travel to the Dadar and Panvel stores as per the agreed schedule.

**Weekly Planning with the Marketing Team and Agency**

title: Senior Performance Marketing Associate
description:
About Condé Nast
 



 Condé Nast is a global media company reaching more than 1 billion consumers across 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. Condé Nast India produces premium titles including Vogue, GQ, Condé Nast Traveller and Architectural Digest (AD), creating compelling content and experiences for some of India’s most influential audiences.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Associate with strong hands\-on expertise across Meta Ads and Google Ads to plan, execute, optimise and scale paid media campaigns across Condé Nast India’s brands, events and digital initiatives.
 



 This is a hands\-on performance marketing role requiring experience across conversion and lead generation campaigns, full\-funnel strategy, audience segmentation, budget allocation, optimisation, tracking and measurement. Strong working knowledge of Meta Pixel, Conversion API (CAPI), GA4 and Google Tag Manager (GTM) is important.
 



 We are looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands\-on execution and can identify
 *why* 
 a campaign is or isn’t performing and turn those insights into action.
 



  





 What You’ll Do
 


* Own performance marketing campaigns end\-to\-end across Meta Ads and Google Ads, including planning, setup, execution, optimisation and reporting.
* Plan and execute Conversion/Sales and Lead Generation campaigns across the full funnel, from prospecting and awareness to conversion and retargeting.
* Build and optimise campaign structures across audiences, targeting, placements, bidding strategies, budgets and creatives.
* Own audience strategy and segmentation, including prospecting, custom audiences, lookalikes, remarketing and first\-party audiences.
* Manage budgets and make data\-led decisions around allocation, pacing and scaling based on performance and business priorities.
* Optimise against key metrics including CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL/CPA, CVR, CAC and ROAS.
* Run structured creative, audience, messaging and landing\-page tests to improve conversion and efficiency.
* Analyse campaign and funnel performance to identify drop\-offs, inefficiencies and growth opportunities.
* Work closely with creative and content teams to provide performance\-led creative insights and recommendations.
* Manage and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, conversion events and tracking, and work with CAPI/server\-side tracking where required.
* Use GA4 and GTM for event tracking, conversion measurement, campaign analysis and troubleshooting.
* Maintain UTM and tracking frameworks and monitor attribution and cross\-platform performance.
* Translate data into clear insights, recommendations and next steps for internal stakeholders.



  





 What We’re Looking For
 


* 4\+ years of hands\-on performance marketing experience, with direct responsibility for campaign setup, execution, optimisation and reporting.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, including Google Search and paid social.
* Proven experience managing Conversion/Sales and Lead Generation campaigns.
* Strong understanding of full\-funnel strategy, audience segmentation, targeting, retargeting, bidding and budget allocation.
* Hands\-on understanding of Meta Pixel, event tracking, custom conversions and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of CAPI/server\-side tracking, GA4 and GTM.
* Strong understanding of performance metrics including CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL/CPA, CVR, CAC and ROAS and how they connect to business outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify what to scale, optimise, test or stop.
* Ability to use performance data to provide actionable creative and campaign recommendations.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly explain performance, insights and recommendations.
* Comfortable taking ownership and working independently while collaborating across creative, content, web/development and business teams.



 Culture Fit
 


* You thrive in a fast\-paced, ownership\-driven environment where ideas move quickly from strategy to execution.
* You have a test\-and\-learn mindset and are curious about why campaigns perform the way they do.
* You are analytical, accountable and have strong communication skills.
* You are comfortable working across multiple teams and priorities.
* You balance strategic thinking with a willingness to be hands\-on in execution.

title: Strategy Director
description:
We are looking for an experienced Strategy Director with a strong background in brand and corporate strategy.
 



  





 This role is for someone who has spent meaningful time working with large, complex organisations and understands the role brand can play in solving corporate and business challenges.
 



  





 You should be comfortable getting underneath a problem, understanding the business, its ambitions, audiences, competitive context and organisational realities, before determining what the brand needs to do. The work may involve positioning, rebuilding value systems, corporate identity, organization culture, brand architecture, portfolio strategy, transformation or creating greater clarity across a complex organisation.
 



  





 You will lead significant strategy engagements, work closely with senior clients and partner with our creative and client leadership teams to turn complex business questions into clear, compelling strategic direction.
 



  





**What Your Bring** 



* 10\+ years of experience in brand strategy, strategic planning, brand consulting or a closely related discipline, preferably within a brand, strategic, research/insight consultancy or agency environment; relevant senior client\-side experience will also be considered
* Significant experience working with large corporate organisations and complex businesses, with an understanding of how they operate and how strategic decisions are made and aligned internally
* The confidence and credibility to work directly with senior marketing and business leaders, to lead conversations, challenge assumptions and defend a strategic point of view
* Experience navigating organisational complexity ie multiple businesses, multiple brands, audiences, stakeholders, markets or competing priorities
* Deep understanding of corporate branding and how brand can help address complex business and organisational challenges.
* The ability to independently frame complex or ambiguous problems, identify the questions that matter, interrogate research and information, and develop a clear strategic recommendation
* Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to turn complex thinking into clear, compelling and actionable strategic direction, as well as the ability to faciliate workshops where thinking is developed and new perspectives are uncovered
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the relationship between brand, reputation, growth and long\-term business value



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Lead major brand strategy engagements end\-to\-end \- diagnosing the business and brand challenge, defining the strategic problem and developing the solution
* Draw on research, business information and stakeholder perspectives to uncover insights, challenge assumptions and identify the strategic questions that matter
* Translate complex organisational and business issues into clear, actionable strategic frameworks and recommendations and develop a feasible roadmap where needed
* Advise senior clients on strategic choices, helping them navigate competing priorities and build alignment and conviction around a direction
* Lead workshops and strategic conversations with business leadership teams and other senior stakeholders
* Partner closely with our Executive Creative Director, designers and client leadership teams to ensure strategy translates into distinctive and relevant creative work
* Play a senior strategic role in new business and pitches, helping define the problem, identify the opportunity and shape the strategic narrative
* Mentor and guide strategists, while contributing to Please See//'s strategic frameworks, methodologies and point of view

**What You'll Own** 



* **Paid \& outbound channels:**

 AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 At Sovos, we're looking for a Product Marketing Specialist or Senior Specialist for Pricing \& Monetisation to help turn commercial strategy into the data, systems, and processes that make it work at scale. This is a highly execution\-oriented role where you'll work closely with our Vice President for Product Marketing and Go\-To\-Market Strategy and the Principal PMM for Pricing and Monetisation, ensuring our pricing and product information is accurate, accessible, and actionable across the business.
   

  

**More Specifically, You Will**
* Analyse pricing, packaging, SKU, and product data to identify trends, inconsistencies, and opportunities, and maintain competitive intelligence to support informed decision\-making.
* Build recurring reports and dashboards, and conduct ad hoc analysis to help Product Marketing and leadership understand pricing performance and support strategic pricing decisions.
* Maintain accurate product, SKU, packaging, and pricing information across internal systems, coordinating updates across Product Marketing, Product Management, Finance, and Sales Operations.
* Work closely with Sales Operations to maintain pricing information in Salesforce and make it easier for reps to create custom quotes in the CPQ system, supporting updates to product catalogues and related fields.
* Support the Principal Product Marketing Manager with research, analysis, and preparation for major pricing and packaging initiatives, turning analysis into clear charts, presentations, and insights.
* Support pricing and packaging projects from analysis through implementation, tracking actions and deadlines, coordinating across teams, and monitoring post\-launch results to flag issues or unexpected outcomes.
* Leverage AI tools to improve data analysis, reporting efficiency, and insight generation, continuously looking for ways to make commercial processes simpler, faster, and more scalable.


 What You Bring to Sovos
   

  

* You've built solid experience in product marketing, business analysis, commercial operations, sales operations, product operations, or a related field, ideally 2–4 years.
* You have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, excellent attention to detail, and comfort working with large datasets and spreadsheets, with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
* Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is strongly preferred, along with the ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations.
* You have strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* You're comfortable working with global teams across multiple time zones and working independently while knowing when to escalate issues, with comfort using AI\-assisted workflows to enhance productivity.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, technology, finance, or pricing is a plus, along with a Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, finance, economics, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.


 The Process
   

  

 We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:
   

  

 1
   

  

 Pre\-Employment Assessment
   

  

 Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.
   

  

 2
   

  

 Video Interview
   

  

 A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.
   

  

 3
   

  

 Meeting with a Recruiter
   

  

 A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.
   

  

 4
   

  

 Live Interviews with the Hiring Team
   

  

 Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day\-to\-day of the role.
   

  

 Life at Sovos
   

  

 The tools to enhance your life \- because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
   

  

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
* Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
* Hybrid Work Arrangement
* Annual Health Check\-up


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
   

  

**Company Background**
 Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150\+ countries.
   

  

 More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**Company** 

 CloudWalker Streaming Technologies (CloudTV)    
 




  





**Department** 

 Marketing — OS Platform, Content \& Ads
 




  





**Reports to** 

 Founder \& CEO, with the Head of Marketing as consulting mentor
 




  





**Works with** 

 Product, BD, Ad Sales, OEM/Partnerships     
 




  





**Location** 

 In\-office, Mumbai
 




  





**Experience** 

 2–4 years (tech / startup / SaaS / AdTech / OTT / media)     
 




  





**Type** 

 Full\-time
 




  





  





**The role in one line** 





 Turn everything CloudTV builds — an operating system, a content ecosystem, an ad platform, a founder's conviction \- into the stories, campaigns, and assets that grow four audiences: OEMs, content partners, advertisers, and viewers.
 




  





  





**Why this role exists** 





 CloudTV is India's first homegrown, AOSP\-based certified Smart TV OS \- live across a large device fleet and 300\+ OEM brands, with its own app store, Voice assistant, Airstream FAST channels, and a full CTV ad stack. We win on a simple idea: a neutral, open platform partners build on, versus closed players who embed their own services and keep the data and ad revenue. That story isn't being told at the speed it deserves. You'll come in early in your career, absorb the business fast, and build the marketing engine from strategy through execution. The ceiling is Head of Product Marketing.
 




  





  





**What makes marketing here different** 





 You market a product that is the audience's screen \- home screen, boot screen, screensaver, mastheads, app store, content rails on millions of TVs, inches from live cricket, festival releases, and the biggest OTT titles. The craft is learning to wield that: time campaigns to content moments, use content partners to sell the platform, use the platform to sell to advertisers.
 




  





  





**What you'll own** 




**B2B \- three ecosystems to grow** 




  





**1\.** 
**OEM \& brand ecosystem.** 

 Keep our TV brands and manufacturers close and selling — every new feature, partnership, milestone, app, content type, and go\-to\-market technology. Always\-on, not one\-off: partner newsletters, Instagram, WhatsApp\-ready forwards, festive greetings, building to the annual CloudTV partner summit, which you help shape end\-to\-end.
 




  





**2\.** 
**Content \& application ecosystem.** 

 Build the narrative and outreach that attracts more apps, FAST channels, and services onto the CloudTV app store and partnership ecosystem — turning every content win into the conversation that pulls the next partner in.
 




  





**3\.** 
**Advertiser ecosystem.** 

 Work as an extension of the CloudTV Ads team. Turn campaign metrics into case studies, data reports, and pitch decks; keep sales decks current with new ad units; translate the ad stack into narratives that win brands and agencies. Genuine curiosity about CTV/OTT/linear advertising, measurement, and audience data is essential.
 




  





**Across all of it** 





 PR, blogs, POV/thought\-leadership on the CTV ecosystem, spokesperson prep, sales\-enablement kits, and collateral for factory lines, retail, and the website — all timed to the product roadmap, partnership milestones, and content moments.
 




  





  





**What we're looking for** 




**•** 

 2–4 years in marketing at a tech startup, SaaS, media/OTT, or AdTech company \- hungry for more than the title implies
 




**•** 

 Product\-marketing instincts: simplify technical, data\-heavy ideas without losing accuracy
 




**•** 

 A storyteller's eye: find the narrative inside a dataset or feature list
 




**•** 

 Range in writing: partner pitch, LinkedIn post, press release, consumer caption
 




**•** 

 AI\-native and self\-sufficient: no designer here \- you use AI tools daily to design, draft, and ship polished, on\-brand assets yourself
 




**•** 

 Comfortable with ambiguity; defines their own briefs and moves
 




**•** 

 Curiosity about where CTV, OTT, linear, and FAST are heading
 




**•** 

 Hands\-on experience running a brand's LinkedIn and Instagram is a strong plus
 




**•** 

 Bachelor's in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related
 




  





  





**Why CloudTV** 



* Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the founder on a national story — a homegrown platform taking on the biggest names in tech — with room to build a marketing function from the ground

HEAD OF US GTM
 



  





 Company: Pepper
 



 Location / Time Zone: US Market (US time zone), Mumbai
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



  





 About Pepper
 



  





 Pepper is building a new category of content and SEO growth platform, where strategy, content, technology, automation, and AI come together to drive measurable business outcomes.
 



  





 We are now extending this foundation to build a modern enterprise growth engine, and we are looking to hire our first Head of US GTM to own and scale our go\-to\-market motion in the US market.
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 As Head of US GTM, you will own the entire go\-to\-market strategy and execution for the US: pipeline, demand generation, sales alignment, positioning, and revenue growth across new business and expansion. You will define how Pepper wins in the US market and build the engine to get there.
 



  





 This is both a strategic and a hands\-on role. You will set the GTM strategy and operating rhythm, then roll up your sleeves to build programs, run experiments, and drive results. You will work shoulder to shoulder with sales, product, product marketing, and customer success to deliver a consistent customer journey and accountable, measurable growth. This role primarily works in the US time zone.
 



  





 What You Will Do
 



  





 • Own US GTM strategy and revenue. Define and execute the go\-to\-market plan for the US, and own pipeline and revenue targets across new business and expansion in partnership with sales and customer success leaders.
 



 • Build the demand generation engine. Create sustained, iterative programs across demand channels: paid marketing, email, SEO, conversion rate optimization, and, over time, ABM, social, and content marketing.
 



 • Sharpen positioning and messaging. Partner with product marketing to ensure clear, compelling positioning and a consistent experience across the full customer journey.
 



 • Drive funnel performance. Rigorously audit the full funnel, surface data\-driven insights, and make fast adjustments to accelerate growth. Work closely with the SDR function to improve lead\-to\-discovery conversion.
 



 • Collaborate and prioritize. Work cross\-functionally and use data to focus the team on the right initiatives in the right order.
 



 • Present strategy and results to leadership. Articulate key initiatives and present performance reviews including financials, test results, forecasts, and metrics. Hold yourself and your team accountable for outcomes.
 



 • Stay hands\-on. Contribute directly to campaign development, content, and tactical execution as needed.
 



  





 What You Will Bring
 



  





 • 10\+ years of GTM, demand generation, and/or digital marketing experience, with B2B and enterprise software experience a strong plus
 



 • 4\+ years in a leadership role, ideally building and scaling GTM motions for a new or growing market (experience managing contractors and distributed teams is a plus)
 



 • A proven, data\-driven operator who has built multi\-channel demand programs across geos and segments and delivered against aggressive growth targets
 



 • Experience owning pipeline and revenue, and managing or working closely with the SDR function to improve conversion
 



 • Experience launching or scaling GTM in the US market, working with US stakeholders
 



 • Strong command of marketing automation tools, and Google Analytics
 



 • A collaborative team player who partners effectively with marketing, sales, product, and customer success to hit business goals
 



 • A detail\-oriented operator who can cohere teams, drive efficiency, and thrive in a fast\-paced organization
 



 • A track record of setting, exceeding, tracking, and communicating meaningful goals
 



 • A self\-starter who operates with limited guidance, knows when to ask for help, and brings flexibility, adaptability, and accountability
